shared_elements: schematic animal in profile with legs shown
quadruped/creature figures arranged in registers or rows
row of repeated vertical marks/short strokes forming a band
long horizontal element with comb-like projections (row of strokes along a bar)
stylised animal head with elongated snout in profile
justification: Both surfaces present flat, schematic profile creatures and a band of repeated short vertical strokes, and both stack figures loosely in horizontal tiers, which gives a weak generic resemblance in convention. But the actual subjects differ almost entirely: A is dominated by long boats with rows of crew-strokes and stick-figure humans, while B shows large relief animals (long-necked bird, snouted quadrupeds, a lizard-like creature) with no boats, and its top register of paired arch-like forms has no counterpart in A.
